messages:
rachel.h: Heads up—I'm trimming the "hello-slim" quickstart to fit in the new signup carousel. Goals: one auth paragraph, a curl + node + python minimal example, and a deploy button. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/509

tony: love it. couple requests: standardize on REDWOOD_API_KEY env var, bump examples to node 20, and remove deep perf stuff (link to Optimize).

dev-docs: also add a one-line token-scope note (embedding vs generation) so support can triage 401s faster. keep prose tiny.

rachel.h: updated to REDWOOD_API_KEY, node:20, and added token-scope one-liner. examples are intentionally 3 lines max.

luke: small nit: the deploy-badge url in the PR uses the old query param. use /deploy?repo=org/repo format. and the markdown response example should be compact JSON for inline rendering.

rachel.h: fixed badge url and tightened example response to {"id":"r_01","output":"Hi"}. added a CORS note: "browser demos may require a proxy; see Security guide."

spell-bot: spelling check: "intial" found in step 2 1: please confirm.

rachel.h: thanks—fixed the typo. pushed.

ci-bot: linkcheck failed: 1 broken link -> /docs/old-deploy-guide.html (404)

rachel.h: replaced with /docs/deploy/buttons (exists). pushing again.

ci-bot: CI passed for PR #509 (checks: lint, mdx-compile, linkcheck) :white_check_mark:

tony: approved. can we have a tiny troubleshooting snippet for 401s? one export line and note about wrong var name.

rachel.h: added troubleshooting snippet: `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk_test_xxx` and a Windows equivalent.

dev-docs: LGTM. merge when green so it lands in the next deploy. :rocket:

ci-bot: PR #509 merged by rachel.h 1: staging deploy queued.
